w07-street.observed_description: One continuous street photo: a bakery window full of bread, a bookstore window full of books, a brick building with a blue-and-white police car in front, and a small gas station.
w07-street.note: Usable: four separate places, each about a quarter of the width.

w08-signs.observed_description: One continuous lakeside park photo: a no-swimming sign at the shore, a no-bikes sign on the path, a no-photos sign in front of a small white museum, and an empty bench with no sign.
w08-signs.note: Usable: the pictograms read at 800 px; the museum's tiny name is unreadable.
